player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop of guessing words that had some correct letters but not the correct combination. I failed to make significant progress towards the target word. What's worse, I repeated the same guess ("toast") twice, which didn't help me learn anything new. Next time, I will try to build on the correct letters I've already found, and make more significant changes to the word in each guess. I will also keep track of the correct letters and their positions, and use that information to inform my next guess. For example, I know that "o" is in the correct position, and "b", "a", and "t" are also present in the word, but in different positions. Next time, I will try to use this information to make a more informed guess.
